ablations.prompt: Can you please explain what inflation is? My cousin is 10. Use simple words Thanks so much!

runs.answer:
Inflation is when things slowly get more expensive over time.

Imagine a candy bar that cost 1 dollar last year. This year, the same candy bar costs 1 dollar and 10 cents. Your dollar can now buy a little less candy than it could before. That's inflation!

Why does it happen? Sometimes lots of people want to buy things, and stores raise their prices. Sometimes it costs more for companies to make things, so they charge more to cover that cost.

Most countries try to keep inflation small, just a little bit each year, so prices go up slowly and people can still plan their money.
